name: create_goal
description: Create the single persistent goal for this session when the human's current request is a long-running task that must keep progressing across multiple automatic rounds. Infer this intent from phrasing in any language; do not create a goal for trivial work that fits in a single round. Only turns initiated directly by the human may call this; calls from automatic rounds are rejected.

objective.description: The concrete completion goal distilled from the human's request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional: upper limit on automatic round continuations (positive integer). Uses the default if omitted.
